title: Solo Leveling
altTitles: Ore Dake Level Up na Ken
俺だけレベルアップな件
Solo Leveling: I Alone Level Up
description: In a world where awakened humans known as Hunters battle deadly monsters, Sung Jinwoo is known as the weakest Hunter of all mankind. After a disastrous encounter in a high-level dungeon leaves his party dead and him on the brink of death, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole Player, granting him the unique ability to level up without limit. As Jinwoo grows stronger, he uncovers the secrets behind the System, the dungeons, and his own extraordinary destiny.
author: Chugong / DUBU (REDICE Studio) / h-goon
